title: fix(plugin-tree,plugin-dashboard): object-tree, object-pivot and object-data-table re-read on the data-invalidation bus (objectui#10778)
body:
Fixes #10778
Clause-②: no — three blocks start re-reading on the bus they already subscribe to by contract; no declared surface moves

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM, session `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`, so that id is also this run's: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`), from claim comment 5857228730 and triage 5857084100 on objectui#10778. Branch `claude/issue-10778-bus-readers-third-batch`, cut from `origin/main` `dac022c4e4` (BASE); head `72c4b48780`.

## What changed

Each of the three fetch effects now names the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for the object it queries, the objectui#10623 shape (same hook, same matcher `dataChangeMatches`, no second channel, no remount):

- `packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`: `useDataInvalidation(dataSource ? dataObjectName : undefined)`, and `invalidationNonce` joins the record effect's dependency list.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectPivotTable.tsx`: `useDataInvalidation(fetchesForItself ? schema.objectName : undefined)`, where `fetchesForItself` is the effect's own fetch condition (a data source, an `objectName`, no bound rows, no authored rows); the nonce joins the fetch effect's dependencies.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx`: the same, in the fetch effect only. ⛔ The schema / masked-field draw window (objectui#10657) is not touched.
- Pins beside each: `ObjectTree.invalidationRefetch-10778.test.tsx`, `ObjectPivotTable.invalidationRefetch-10778.test.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.invalidationRefetch-10778.test.tsx`.
- `.changeset/10778-tree-bus-reader.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-tree`: patch) and `.changeset/10778-dashboard-bus-readers.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: patch).

## H1 — reproduced on BASE

The three pins run with the three source files at BASE (blob-verified on disk) and the head pins kept: `Tests 10 failed | 3 passed (13)`, `VERDICT command-exit 1`. Every read-after-event case is red with `expected "vi.fn()" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times`: fetch count 1 on mount, still 1 after `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })`, still 1 after a change to the block's own object. The three green cases are the static-rows controls. In every red case the bare `useDataInvalidation` reader beside the block read nonce 1, so the event reached subscribers.

Lit control with a block that already reads the bus: in the census probe below, on BASE, in the same harness, `object-metric`, `object-grid`, `object-chart` and the other readers went 1 → 2 after `'*'` and 2 → 3 after their own object, and stayed put after an unrelated object.

| block (BASE) | mount | after `'*'` | after own object | after unrelated object |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-tree` | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `object-pivot` | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `object-data-table` | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| `object-metric` (lit control) | 1 | 2 | 3 | 3 |

On head all three read 1 → 2 → 3 → 3.

## H2 — census

Instrument: a scratch probe (deleted, never committed) under `apps/console/src/__tests__`, the one project that depends on every console plugin. It renders each type through the real `SchemaRenderer`, under the console's real registrations (components, fields and the 15 console plugins), over a counting fake adapter (`find`, `findOne`, `aggregate`, `count`, `queryDataset`), with a `RecordContextProvider` for the `record:*` family and `AdapterCtx` for `element:*`. Per row it counts reads on mount, after `'*'`, after its own object and after an unrelated object. A bare `useDataInvalidation` reader in every row read nonce 2 (both matching events arrived). Run on BASE (the three files at BASE) and on head.

**Count.**
- `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`: 59 entries, all 59 rendered.
  - 18 read on mount. Of those, 13 re-read after `'*'` on BASE, and 5 do not: `object-tree` and `object-pivot` (this PR), plus `record:line_items`, `record:activity` and `record:history`.
  - Two more read through a path this harness does not drive. `object-map` issues no read here because the probe does not mock its map library; its committed pin `ObjectMap.invalidationRefetch-10623` covers it, and it reads the bus by source. `dashboard` reads only through its widgets (rows below).
  - `record:reference_rail` issued no read under the probe's config. By source, its fetch names no nonce. NOT MEASURED at runtime.
- Console-registered keys beyond `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`: 37 further keys rendered, plus 12 composite rows (a `dashboard` / `dashboard-grid` per widget kind, a dataset-bound `object-chart`, `report` and `spec-report`, and `list-view` in tree mode).
  - Readers: `calendar`, `detail-view`, `object-gallery`, `object-view`, `timeline`, `view`, `object-chart` over a dataset, the `dashboard` metric widget, and `list-view` in tree mode.
  - No reader on BASE: `object-data-table`, `tree` (the `object-tree` alias), the object-bound table widget of `dashboard` and of `dashboard-grid` (both render `object-data-table`), and `report` / `spec-report` over a dataset.

**Rows without a reader on BASE, and where each lands:**

| block | reads on mount | after `'*'` | taken here? |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `object-tree` / `tree` | `find` | none | yes, head: 1 → 2 |
| `object-pivot` | `find` | none | yes, head: 1 → 2 (flat `objectName` and element `dataSource: { object }`) |
| `object-data-table` | `find` | none | yes, head: 1 → 2 |
| `dashboard`, table widget over `{ provider: 'object' }` | `find` (via `object-data-table`) | none | yes, rides the table: head 1 → 2 |
| `dashboard-grid`, table widget over `{ provider: 'object' }` | `find` (via `object-data-table`) | none | yes, rides the table: head 1 → 2 |
| `dashboard`, dataset-bound widgets (bar / table / pivot) | none: renders `This data source does not support dataset queries.` | none | no, see Acceptance notes |
| `report` / `spec-report` over a dataset | `queryDataset` | none | no, see Acceptance notes |
| `record:activity`, `record:history` | `find('sys_activity')` | none | no, see Acceptance notes |
| `record:line_items` | `find` on the child object | none | no, see Acceptance notes |
| `record:reference_rail` | NOT MEASURED (probe config) | NOT MEASURED | no, see Acceptance notes |

## H3 — the seam

Each block names its object for `dataChangeMatches` as follows.

- **`object-tree`**: `dataObjectName`, the `object` provider's own object.
  - It resolves both from `objectName` and from `data: { provider: 'object', object }` with no `objectName`. The pin covers both.
  - Inline rows (a `data` array, or `{ provider: 'value', items }`) name no object and query no adapter, so the hook gets `undefined` and nothing subscribes. Pinned: no adapter `find`, and no extra `ValueDataSource.find`.
  - With no data source, nothing subscribes.
  - **Host-fed rows** (a `data` prop, the `list-view` tree) still subscribe. The `object` arm runs its own full query ahead of those rows, so the tree's freshness must not rest on the host's rows moving. The host fetches only its display columns, and a host that hands an equal re-read down as the same array (what AGENTS.md #10 asks of a provider) would never move the dependency for a write outside its projection. Measured cost: today's ListView hands down a fresh array on every re-read, so a `list-view` tree runs its query twice per event (BASE 1, head 2). The probe re-parented a row outside ListView's `$select`, and the tree showed the new parent on BASE and on head alike.
- **`object-pivot`**: `schema.objectName`. That is the flat key, or the element `dataSource: { object }` that `ObjectPivotBlock` binds onto it before this component reads it. Pinned: both spellings.
  - Bound rows and authored `data` rows do not subscribe. Pinned: authored rows query nothing.
- **`object-data-table`**: `schema.objectName`, with the same gate as the pivot.
- **`ObjectDataTable`'s drill-down path**:
  - A row click stores the clicked row in `drillRecord` and opens `RecordDetailDrawer` over that snapshot. The drawer fetches nothing of its own.
  - After a bus event the table re-reads its rows. An open record drawer keeps the snapshot it was opened with until it is reopened.
  - `DrillDownDrawer`, the drill list of the pivot and metric blocks, lists its records through `ObjectDataTable` and therefore re-reads with it. The chart's drill uses its own drawer, which mounts `object-data-table` through `SchemaRenderer`, so it re-reads too.
- All three re-read in place. The pivot and the table draw their skeleton only while they have no rows, and the table shows its refresh bar during a re-read. The tree keeps its component state (the pin flips a node's expansion and reads it back after the re-read).

## Pins and ablation

Pins, each rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the package's own registration, with a bare `useDataInvalidation` reader as the lit control:

- per block: one read on mount, a second after `'*'`, a second after its own object, and none after an unrelated object;
- static-rows controls: authored rows (and, for the tree, the `value` provider) never query;
- the tree's `data`-provider spelling and host-fed rows;
- the pivot's element `dataSource` spelling;
- the `dashboard` block's object table widget.

| leg | mutation (on-disk proof) | result over the three pin files |
|:--|:--|:--|
| head `72c4b48780` | none | 13 passed (inside the suite run below) |
| A1, reverse | the three source files checked out at BASE; blobs `643b00ff3f` / `eeba53e84a` / `8dcddfd033` == BASE; `invalidationNonce` hits 0 in each | `Tests 10 failed, 3 passed (13)`, the static controls green. Restore `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`: blobs == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes |
| A2, ablation | `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) drops `invalidationNonce` from `ObjectPivotTable`'s dependency list: anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `d0d30124fb` → `3bf2fe0f00` | `Tests 3 failed, 10 passed (13)`: exactly the pivot's three read-after-event cases; the tree's 5, the table's 4 and the pivot's control stay green. Restored by the tool: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty |

No `dist/` preflight applies: every pin imports its package through `./index` (source), and the vitest alias map resolves `@object-ui/*` to source.

## Gates (head `72c4b48780`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-tree/ packages/plugin-dashboard/`: `Test Files 159 passed (159)`, `Tests 1405 passed (1405)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-tree type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` (script names echoed; each `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`), after `turbo run build` of both dependency closures (13 tasks): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - The first run caught TS2493 in the tree pin: the untyped fake `find` made `mock.calls[0][0]` an empty tuple. Repaired in `72c4b48780`.
- Lint, narrowed and measured: `eslint --format json` over the six touched files read 6 files, 0 errors and 60 warnings.
  - The three source files' per-rule warning counts equal BASE's (tree 21 `no-explicit-any` + 2 `exhaustive-deps`; pivot 8; table 20 + 2 + 1). Each new pin carries 2 `no-explicit-any` warnings.
  - Population: every file resolves a config (`--print-config`).
  - `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and the diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.
- `check:phantom-deps` ✅; `check:new-line-citations` `VERDICT … 0 new citation(s)`; `check:control-bytes` OK; `check:test-path-roots` OK; `check:vi-mock-specifiers` OK; `check:unreferenced-sources` OK; `check:pending-changeset-literals` ✅; `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅ (2 changesets).
- `check:changeset-claims` is report-only. It names four pending changesets that mention `ObjectDataTable.tsx` / `ObjectTree.tsx` (5876, 7125, 8253, 5692). Each paragraph was read, and none is falsified by this change.
- CI owns the repo-wide lint and the full test run.

## Serial

- `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD` against a fresh `origin/main` (`f812f37897`, fetched into a private ref): clean, tree `23654b2a99`. Main has moved two comments inside `ObjectTree.tsx` since BASE, and they merge clean.
- Against `claude/issue-10657-masked-first-paint` (`e742e22d2e`, objectui#10657 seat 4): clean, tree `139781d4de`. That branch edits `ObjectDataTable.tsx` (26 lines, the draw window). This PR edits only the fetch effect and the lines above it.
- PR objectui#10777 is not touched.

## Acceptance notes

**Census rows not taken, each needing more than this shape:**
1. **`dashboard` dataset-bound widgets (`DatasetWidget`).** Rendered through `SchemaRenderer` (the path a page takes), they issue no query at all and paint `This data source does not support dataset queries.`, although the context adapter has `queryDataset`. `DashboardRenderer` takes `dataSource` only as a React prop, and `SchemaRenderer` injects none. Once that is repaired, the widget still needs a reader:
   - its effect keys on `[signature]` alone;
   - a re-read resets `rows` to `[]`, which blanks the tile;
   - its object is known only from the answer (`res.object`), the way `ObjectChart`'s dataset arm keys on `datasetObject`.
   Reported to the seat as a class (a) finding.
2. **`report` / `spec-report` over a dataset (`plugin-report`).** `queryDataset` on mount, and none after `'*'` or after its own object. These keys are console-registered, not `PUBLIC_BLOCKS`. The reader would key on the object the answer names (the `ObjectChart` dataset shape).
3. **`record:activity`, `record:history` (`plugin-detail`).** Each self-fetches with no reader, and each fetches only under a record context. `PageView` provides none, so they are outside objectui#10519's path; their host is `RecordDetailView`. The same shape would fit: `useDataInvalidation(objectName, recordId)`.
4. **`record:line_items` (`plugin-form`).** Self-fetches with no reader. It does NOT fetch only under a record context: `LineItemsPanel` resolves `parentId = schema.parentId || schema.recordId || record?.recordId` and takes `dataSource` from `useSchemaContext`, so a stored page node with an authored `parentId` / `recordId` reads `find(childObject)` on mount with no record context. It is inside objectui#10519's path, and the seat filed it with report/spec-report (row 2) as objectui#10814, a blocker of objectui#10519.
5. **`record:reference_rail`.** By source, its fetch names no nonce. NOT MEASURED at runtime (no read under the probe's config).

**Measured, not changed here:**
- A `list-view` tree now reads twice per bus event: once on the nonce, once on ListView's fresh rows (H3). That is the cost of not resting on the host's array moving.
- The tree swaps to its `Loading…` placeholder during any re-read (pre-existing for every refetch, such as a filter change). Its component state survives the re-read, but its table DOM and scroll do not.
- The triage's "the pivot and table widgets inside a `dashboard` block ride the same components" holds for the table widget only. `DashboardRenderer` renders its retired placeholder for a non-dataset pivot widget, and a dataset pivot goes through `DatasetWidget` (row 1). `dashboard-grid`'s object table rides `ObjectDataTable`.
- A correction to this branch's own history: commit `a03e677205`'s message says a `list-view` tree kept a re-parented row under its old parent. The next measurement falsified that: on BASE the tree did re-read through ListView's fresh rows. `6fb970853b` states the reason as measured. The code is unchanged by the correction.

**What unblocks objectui#10519:** with this PR, every `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` entry and every console-registered object-bound block that reads on mount on a page with no record context re-reads after `'*'`, with two exceptions:
- the `dashboard` block's dataset-bound widgets, which today do not load through that path at all (row 1);
- the console-registered `report` / `spec-report` over a dataset (row 2).
Whether those two go first, or travel as follow-ups behind PR objectui#10777, is the seat's call.


## Round 2

Round 1's contract review (`5857890530`) FAILed on two changeset sentences; the code, pins, semver and merge state passed. Round 2 (`0c7494fb39`) is text only:
- `.changeset/10778-dashboard-bus-readers.md`: the table sentence names the `dashboard` table widget and the drill-down record list, and adds that a `drillDown.report` drill and the single-record drawer a table row opens do not re-read.
- `.changeset/10778-tree-bus-reader.md`: "Before, a tree that no host handed rows to refreshed … only when its host remounted it" (a `list-view` tree already refreshed on ListView's re-read).
- This body: Acceptance note 4 (`record:line_items` is inside objectui#10519's path; filed as objectui#10814) and H3's drill attribution are corrected, by the seat at landing from the dev's `pr_body_replacement`.
